disclosures: Experimental, uncalibrated and unapproved; not a prescription.
An absent case is not_applicable and claims no posterior; it is never a negative finding or a fake negative review posterior.

Unresolved, unknown, not_assessed, missing or conflicting required context pauses; absent is never coerced from not assessed and no missing finding maps to No; a missing Dx item never becomes a negative finding.

Acute Dystonia Dx Criteria supports measurement; its items alone never establish a total and no score threshold determines intervention; severity is independent mild, moderate or severe and never derived from a total.

Urgent banner comes from saved structured airway inputs, not model output, and never shows a fabricated risk percentage; Table 10 prescribing details are background only and not copied as activation metadata.
No dose, route, frequency, active/stopped or free-text fields are collected or accepted.
rendering_contract: Candidate wording for S45 deterministic distribution rendering; each queried state has a branch, all probabilities remain visible. No probability threshold or posterior-ranked treatment selection is defined. Urgent banner renders from saved inputs in parallel with review topics. Whether outputs behave as deterministic rules or estimated tables is an open assumption for owner review; this wording assumes neither.
